comment: Pictures 1-2 are a photo of the original pedal; the vero layout is the third picture (19x17, populated board on top, cuts and links below). The Scooped / Flat / Boosted mids switch inset (3 pos DPDT carrying a 4n7 and a 10n between Tone 3 and Sw1) is drawn as part of the build and its switch and two caps are included.
uncertain: 4n left of the 12K in the centre of the board: printed clearly, unusual value
rows: one on the board, one on the mids switch
legend: Transistors were 2N5133 which will be hard to source, try 2N5089, BC550C or similar
